_doc: Hand-verified Google place_ids. Text Search matches a NAME, which is not an identifier: it put 53 at 621m, and an address-only rescue picked a 115-review business for Central Park Boathouse when the real one has 5,244. Each entry below was checked by eye. fetch_google_ratings.py uses Place Details for these and skips the geometry test, because a pinned place_id IS the verification.

notes.53: 53 — 53 W 53rd St, New York, NY 10019, USA (4.3*, 723 reviews)
notes.a-a-bake-double-roti-shop: A&A Bake Doubles and Roti — 1337 Fulton St, Brooklyn, NY 11216, USA (4.3*, 1179 reviews). The Beard file carries the same Bed-Stuy shop under two spellings; the slug 'a-a-bake-and-doubles' resolved to this place_id already.

notes.boathouse-cafe: Central Park Boathouse — the same place_id pinned above for the participant slug 'central-park-boathouse'. The 1998 Beard file calls the Loeb Boathouse restaurant 'The Boathouse Cafe'.
notes.catria-nyc: Catria Cucina and Bar — 461 W 34th St. Frnt 1, New York, NY 10001, USA (4.4*, 208 reviews)
notes.central-park-boathouse: Central Park Boathouse — EAST 72ND ST +, Center Dr, New York, NY 10021, USA (4.3*, 5244 reviews)

notes.cote-korean-steakhouse: COTE Flatiron — 16 W 22nd St, New York, NY 10010, USA (4.6*, 4264 reviews). The Beard file names it 'COTE Korean Steakhouse'; Google names the room 'COTE Flatiron', and the extra tokens sank the similarity. Same restaurant the slug 'cote' resolved to.

notes.gotham-bar-grill: Gotham Restaurant — 12 E 12th St, New York, NY 10003, USA (CLOSED_PERMANENTLY, 4.5*, 1346 reviews). Gotham Bar & Grill's room, rebranded 2021 and since closed; the roster already resolved the slug 'gotham' here. Pinning it marks this row closed rather than leaving 1993-2006 awards Unverified.

notes.izakaya-futago: Izakaya Futago — 211 E 43rd St, New York, NY 10017, USA (4.4*, 1065 reviews)

notes.shion-69-leonard-street: 69 Leonard Street — 69 Leonard St, New York, NY 10013, USA (4.5*, 240 reviews, website 69leonardstreet.com whose site collection is titled "SHION"). The restaurant brands itself by its address and Google lists it that way, so a name match reads as an event space; the website is what proves the listing. An earlier hand ruling rejected this match as unverifiable -- the Place Details website field settled it.
notes.tatiana-by-kwame-onwuachi: Tatiana by Kwame Onwuachi — 10 Lincoln Center Plaza, New York, NY 10023, USA (4.4*, 1206 reviews). The award file's address is 'David Geffen Hall, Lincoln Center' — no street number, no ZIP — so the address check read a perfect name match as a disagreement. Same restaurant the slug 'tatiana' resolved to.
notes.the-kunjip: The Kunjip — 32 W 32nd St, New York, NY 10001, USA (4*, 3771 reviews)
